name: interface-design
description: Design and change user interfaces without drift using a persistent DESIGN.md contract, conceptual-model checks, screenshot verification, and blind critic hill-climbing.

interface.shortDescription: Design, change, and hill-climb user interfaces without drift.
interface.longDescription: Provides two companion skills: interface-design for creating new interfaces and making drift-free changes against a persistent DESIGN.md contract with screenshot verification and token checks, and design-hill-climb for multi-round scored audits against blind screenshot-only critics and reference applications.
capabilities: Persistent DESIGN.md contract and token drift checking
Deterministic screenshot capture, squint tests, and side-by-side diffs
Multi-round blind critic hill-climbing against reference applications
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $interface-design to inspect the design contract, capture before/after screenshots, and make this UI change without drift.
